Name: Ragnarok Online Hats (Content Patcher and Json Assets)
Author: Seyph
Description:
Set of hats designed after popular hats from the Ragnarok Online MMORPG, including names and descriptions of the hats to match the ones from the game.


2 versions
[list]
[*]Content Patcher  - configurable vanilla hat replacements
[*]Json Assets 1.2+ - adds hats to Hat Mouse shop [i][b]without [/b][/i]replacing vanilla hats (special thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/26612284-infectmeinjectme/][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/26612284][/url][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/26612284-infectmeinjectme/]infectmeinjectme[/url]﻿﻿!)
[/list]
[size=4][u]Installation (Content Patcher)[/u][/size][list=1]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download the CP version of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Open config.json in a text editor to enable/disable specific hats by setting [b]"true"[/b] or [b]"false"[/b].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list][size=4][u]
Installation (Json Assets)[/u][/size][list=1]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Modding:SMAPI_compatibility&oldid=74245#Json_Assets]Json Assets 1.2+[/url]﻿.
[*]Download the JA version of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[u][size=3]NOTES (Content Patcher):[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Name/description changes do not affect hats that currently exist in the world! It only affects newly created hats.
[*]If a hairstyle change is being forced in 1.0.2, or if some hats are not the same appearance as they used to be after a file update, spawn a new version of the hat, either by re-purchasing it at the Hat Mouse shop or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ and searching for the respective hat.
[/list]
[size=3][u]NOTES (Json Assets):[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]It seems that Json Assets 1.2+ (unofficial update) does not currently support hat names when using a language other than English. Hat names will appear as "true" or "false." Unfortunately, this is not something I can fix.
[/list]
